title: [GMCP 203.030.05] Interoperability and quality: Supply-chain integrity and server/package trust
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-030-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Every install resolves immutable package identity, source, version, digest, signature/provenance, license, SBOM, vulnerabilities, maintainer and runtime before execution. Lockfiles and trusted publishers prevent substitution and dependency confusion; updates are staged, rescanned, diffed and rollbackable; revoked or newly critical artifacts are quarantined; and offline verification uses retained transparency evidence. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
